entries.note: Loaded on a trip between two cities; seen in archived replies of the carrier's tracking API, which the tracker page lists.
At one of the carrier's warehouses, on the way or at destination; its sub-state says whether the cargo is ready for issue. Seen in archived API replies.
Sub-state shown under В рейсе or На складе while the cargo has not reached its destination; seen in archived API replies.
Sub-state of cargo waiting at the destination warehouse; seen in an archived API reply, and the tracker page shows it as a flag next to the waybill.
Flag the tracker page shows next to the waybill once the cargo is handed out; seen in the page's template, not in a capture.
Flag the tracker page shows while the cargo is neither handed out nor ready for issue; a summary, not an event.
The tracker page's message when the waybill exists but the sender has not yet handed the cargo to an Energia warehouse.
